title: Preventing P-Trap Seal Siphonage
description: A fixture trap relies on a water seal to prevent sewer gas from entering living spaces. Siphonage occurs when flowing wastewater creates a vacuum in the drain line, pulling water out of the trap. To prevent this, the trap arm must connect to a properly sized vent before dropping vertically into a main drain stack. S-traps lack this dedicated vent connection, making them prone to self-siphonage. Maintaining the correct trap arm distance and ensuring proper venting preserves the liquid seal in the P-trap, securing a safe barrier against sewer gases.
